title: NAIC CLO/CBO/CDO Tranche RBC Factor Calculator
description: Recomputes the NAIC Life RBC per-tranche capital charge for CLO/CBO/CDO bond tranches against the LR002 Column (2) "CLOs/CBOs/CDOs" factor grid adopted by the RBC Investment Risk & Evaluation (E) Working Group (Proposal 2026-12-IRE, effective for YE2026 filings), including the flat 11.77% BSL thin-tranche surcharge. Sums per-tranche requirements into a portfolio total. Verify-only: recomputes a prescribed charge from declared inputs, never asserts filing compliance.

bsl_thin_tranche.description: True if claimed as a BSL thin tranche (eligible only for designation 2.C or below)

tranche_thickness_pct.description: Current tranche thickness as a percentage (detachment - attachment point)

mcp_tool_definition.name: calculate_naic_clo_rbc_factor
mcp_tool_definition.description: Recomputes NAIC Life RBC per-tranche CLO/CBO/CDO capital charges against the LR002 Column (2) factor grid (Proposal 2026-12-IRE), including the BSL thin-tranche 11.77% surcharge for designation 2.C or below at <=4% thickness. Sums per-tranche requirements into a portfolio total. Verify-only.
